# Loan Contract Audit and Risk Review

This document details critical areas requiring investigation and review within loan contracts, driven by audit findings and ongoing monitoring requirements.

## Key Investigation and Review Points:

*   Investigate interest rates based on audit findings.
*   Review collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Investigate updates to default risk standards.
*   Review default risk on a quarterly basis.
*   Monitor interest rates on a quarterly basis.
